title: Fireflies flash in a secret code
description: On a summer night, fireflies blink in the dark. Each kind of firefly has its own pattern of flashes — like a secret code that says, 'I am over here!'

body.heading: Blinking to say hello
paragraphs: A firefly makes light inside its tummy. It can turn the light on and off, on and off. One kind flashes quick-quick-quick. Another kind makes one long, slow glow.
The flashes are messages. A firefly in the grass flashes its pattern, and a firefly flying above looks for that same pattern. That is how they find each other in the dark.

body.heading: Watch, don't catch
paragraphs: Fireflies are gentle and tiny. If you watch them from a little way away, you can try to copy a pattern with your fingers: blink, blink… blink, blink. Can you tell two different patterns apart?
When the night ends, the fireflies rest in the grass. Leaving them free means they will be back tomorrow night, flashing their secret code again.

takeaway: Each kind of firefly flashes its own pattern of light — a secret code for finding friends in the dark.
